scope: All 231 public JevBench decisions; not the private 534-item leaderboard.
training: No training, model selection, or calibration fitting in this benchmark. Public items were used in upstream development, including reflex; not an unseen test set.
timing: One warmup on an independent synthetic item; one synchronized end-to-end call per public item, shuffled identically for both systems. Single process/model; batch 1; no state reuse between requests.
precision: BF16 for both local systems, no quantization, no decoding.
memory: Process RSS sampled every 20 ms during evaluation; post-run MPS allocation snapshots. Unified memory measurements overlap: do not add them.
comparison: Same state, questions, options and scoring; each author's own prompt/readout. SemIf Score uses JevBench's documented ordinal-option extension.
